component.name: MediaTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" end sub
sub runTask() poster = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TaskPoster") anim = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TaskAnimatedImage") for i = 0 to 10 sleep(30) end for print "poster loadStatus:" + poster.findNode("p").loadStatus print "poster observed:" + poster.observed.toStr() print "anim state:" + anim.findNode("a").state print "anim observedCount:" + anim.observedCount.toStr() m.top.finished = true end sub
